title: Ordered three-tree majority composition
statement: Let $A,B,C$ be finite sets of coordinates, with $A$ disjoint from $B\cup C$ and $B$ disjoint from $C$. Let $T_A,T_B,T_C$ be sign-valued decision trees using coordinates from $A,B,C$, respectively. Define a tree that first runs $T_A$, then runs $T_B$, and then uses the majority continuation rule with their two outputs and $T_C$; its available coordinates are $A\cup(B\cup C)$.
hypotheses_covered: $A,B,C$ are finite subsets of the $n$ coordinates
the three trees use coordinate sets $A,B,C$, respectively
